svg.title: Боковая планка с подъёмом ноги — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Side plank with top-leg abduction. Front-facing view of a figure horizontally oriented with head at left, supported by the lower forearm under shoulder and outer edge of bottom foot. Body forms a straight raised diagonal, free hand on hip. START legs straight and stacked. FINISH same plank with upper leg clearly lifted away from lower leg about 30 degrees; bottom foot and elbow positions unchanged, hips stay elevated. No other support, no equipment. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
